races.title: Create a race
races.description: A race sets heroes' base stats, available skills and the progression tree.

units.title: Add enemy units
units.description: Units are mobs and squads for battles. Create them by hand or import from JSON.

players.title: Invite players
players.description: Send players the invite code from the "Campaign settings" block below.

characters.title: Approve or create a hero
characters.description: Players create hero drafts and you approve them, or you create a hero yourself.

battle-prepare.title: Prepare a battle
battle-prepare.description: Build a battle scene: sides, units, map. Balance tells you whether the fight is fair.

battle-run.title: Run your first battle
battle-run.description: Start a battle and a battle button appears in the players' header.

scenario.title: Write a scenario
scenario.description: Scenes, DM notes and hero bios in a single manuscript.

show.title: Prepare a scene show
show.description: Slides with music that players see on their own screens.

music.title: Add battle music
music.description: A track library for the in-battle player.

ai.title: Connect the AI assistant
ai.description: Your own Claude, OpenAI or Gemini key: a co-author for your scenario and a helper during play.

character.title: Create a hero
character.description: Create a hero draft: race, name, portrait. The DM will approve it.
character.descriptionPending: Your draft is waiting for DM approval. As soon as they accept it, the hero will appear here.

sheet.title: Explore the hero sheet
sheet.description: Stats, skills, spells, artifacts and progression.

battle.title: Join a battle
battle.description: The DM will start a battle and a battle button will appear in the header.

show.title: Scene show
show.description: When the DM shows a scene, it opens in the "Show" section.

races.title: Races are the foundation of heroes
races.body: A race sets base stats, a passive ability and the set of available skills. Without a race, a player cannot create a hero.

skill-trees.title: Progression trees
skill-trees.body: A tree is tied to a race and determines which skills a hero unlocks with levels. Create skills in the library first, then lay them out on the tree.

skills.title: Skill library
skills.body: A skill is a set of effects (bonuses, triggers, reactions) that the battle engine applies automatically. One skill can be used in several trees.

units.title: Units
units.body: Mobs and squads for battles. A unit's level and tier affect battle balance; whole sets are easy to import from JSON.

class-map.title: Class map
class-map.body: The "Map" tab shows what a class gives at each level: abilities, subclass, choices and numbers. Clicking a level takes you to the tab where you can change it; subclasses are added in the "Subclasses" tab.

spells.title: Spells
spells.body: The campaign's spell database. Heroes get spells through skills and levels; in battle they are cast from the spellbook or straight from the map.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.body: Items with bonuses; several artifacts from the same set grant an extra effect. An artifact is unique: one hero holds it, and it can be passed to another.

battles.title: Battle scenes
battles.body: Prepare a battle in advance: sides, participants, map, music. During the session a prepared battle starts with one click.

battle-setup.title: Balance and reserve
battle-setup.body: Balance fits the enemies' strength to the player party; there is no separate difficulty level. Participants can be kept in reserve and brought into the battle later.

battle-scene.title: Running a battle
battle-scene.body: You see the whole map and all sides. You take the units' turns yourself, players act from their phones; the server calculates rolls and damage.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.body: The campaign manuscript: scenes, DM notes, bios. A scenario row can be linked to a show slide or a battle and launched right from the text.

show.title: Scene show
show.body: Slide sets with music. When you switch a slide, it opens in sync on the players' screens.

world.title: World map
world.body: Draw a continent map, place locations and zones, and move heroes between maps. The map can be shown to players through "Show" - everyone sees only their own fog.

compendium-import.title: Compendium import: four steps
compendium-import.body: File, categories, check, confirm. The campaign is not changed until you confirm; the report shows blockers and manual actions.

world.title: World map
world.body: Here you can see your heroes and discovered locations. Tap a location to read its notes, either shared with the party or your own private ones.

character.title: Your hero sheet
character.body: The "Combat", "Abilities", "Magic", "Inventory" and "History" tabs hold everything about your hero. New levels and progression appear here after battles.

draft.title: Hero draft
draft.body: Pick a race, name, stats and portrait; everything can be generated. The draft goes to the DM for approval, and they may send it back with a comment.

battle.title: Battle from your phone
battle.body: When your turn comes, choose an action: move, attack, spell. The server calculates rolls and damage; you end your turn with the end turn button.
